description:
Compute the convex hull of global populated places using gvSIG's geoprocessing tools.

1. Launch gvSIG Desktop (if not already open) and start a new view.
2. Load the shapefile '/home/ga/gvsig_data/cities/ne_110m_populated_places.shp'.
3. Open the Geoprocessing Toolbox (System > Toolbox or via the menu View > Geoprocessing tools).
4. Locate the 'Convex Hull' tool (often under Analysis > Geometry or similar categories).
5. Configure the tool:
   - Input layer: ne_110m_populated_places
   - Output file: Save the result to '/home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/convex_hull_cities.shp'
6. Run the tool.
7. Verify that a new polygon layer covering all points is added to the view.

The task is successful when the valid polygon shapefile exists at the specified output path.
